input.prompt: Speak as a warm, conversational Turkish narrator addressing one curious listener. Sound like a thoughtful person sharing a discovery as it becomes clear, with natural human cadence, varied sentence energy, and quiet curiosity. Let short reveal sentences land, then slow slightly for explanation. Use clear Istanbul Turkish diction and natural pauses. Avoid sermon, classroom lecture, documentary-announcer delivery, exaggerated drama, and a repeated rhetorical rise-and-fall. Do not give every section the same cadence. Pronounce Arabic Quranic words naturally as Arabic, then return smoothly to Turkish.
input.text: Sonra ikinci هُمْ (onlar), gelir ve one alinmis ahiret alanindan sonra faili yeniden kilitler. Ayni grup, ahiret ifadesinin iki yaninda isitilir; boylece son yuklem dogrudan onlara iner. كَٰفِرُونَ (inkarcilar/ortenler), ad cumlesinin yuklemi olarak ayeti kapatir. Etken sifat bicimi, inkarin yerlesmis bir kolektif durus halinde tasindigini verir. Kelimenin bagli oldugu alan ortme, gizleme, hakikati kapatma, nimeti tanimama gibi yonler tasir; burada ahiret edatiyla baglandigi icin ortulen sey sonucun gorunur olmasidir. Ayni kok alaninda gunahin etkisini ortup silen iyilestirici bir yon de bulunur; bu ayette o yon, reddedilen arinma imkaninin karsi tarafinda durur. Son kelime hakikati orten fail adidir: zekatin aritici aktarimi kapanir, ahiretin hesap ufku kapatilir.
